rights_note: The archived Newberry curated exhibit (https://web.archive.org/web/20160825170613id_/http://publications.newberry.org:80/frontiertoheartland/items/show/155) explicitly identifies this United States publication as Chicago: Rufus Blanchard, ca. 1893 and states that the image was published in 1893. The underlying nineteenth-century published work is in the public domain. The current object catalog separately lists 1935 and Copyright Not Evaluated; retain that conflict without assuming a reprint chronology. Publication and image identity were reviewed on 2026-11-03; supporting evidence: https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/blob/df1f36d070b52feec6373ad4cb7ec3c063814f97/evidence/wolf-sauganash-2026-11-03/poster-primary-publication-review/RECOVERY.md
access_notes: The existing local poster was inspected and identified as the same underlying colored print shown by the current Newberry image and its source-attributed Commons copy. The archived exhibit original JPEG is unavailable; documentary identity rests on the specific title, publisher, collection and matching printed caption rather than an archived-image checksum. John R. Kay and Chas. Shober creator attributions have not been verified from primary evidence.
note: A retrospective colored poster depicting 1832, not a contemporary survey or proof of unchanged appearance in July 1835. Related to but distinct from the 1867 NYPL rendering: foreground, bridge arrangement and text differ. Visible architectural form can be compared cautiously, while metric dimensions, hidden fabric, physical plan and world placement remain reconstructed. A fitted diagnostic camera and complete picture match have not been established.
